title: GentleFeet
description: Prevents your tootsies trampling crops, if you are not wearing boots!
body:
![GentleFeet Banner](https://github.com/Knabbiii/GentleFeet/raw/master/.github/assets/gentlefeet-banner.png)
[![Spigot Downloads](https://img.shields.io/spiget/downloads/129991?style=for-the-badge\&logo=spigotmc\&color=79c10f)](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/gentlefeet.129991/) [![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20+-green?style=for-the-badge\&logo=minecraft)](https://www.minecraft.net/) [![Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/Server-Spigot%20%7C%20Paper-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.spigotmc.org/)
**Overview** Protect your crops with **intelligent protection mechanics**. GentleFeet prevents farmland from being trampled by integrating barefoot protection and feather falling enchantment behavior. Ideal for survival and community-oriented servers. --- **Features** | Feature | Description | | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | | Barefoot Protection | Walking without boots will not trample farmland | | Feather Falling Integration | Trample-prevention chance scales with enchantment level | | Live Configuration | Adjust settings during gameplay | | Commands Included | Full admin control with tab-completion | | Debug Mode | Helpful logging for tuning or troubleshooting | | Optional Metrics | bStats support (can be disabled) | **Why GentleFeet?** • No dependencies required • Lightweight design • Event-based for efficiency • Highly configurable • Clear documentation --- **Configuration Options** • Toggle barefoot protection • Configure chance-based protection for feather falling • Editable messages (supports color codes) • Permission-based control • Debug mode and notifications Settings can be changed without restarting the server. --- **Commands and Permissions** **Commands** • `/gentlefeet info` – View plugin details • `/gentlefeet reload` – Reload configuration • `/gentlefeet toggle ` – Enable/disable individual features • `/gentlefeet set ` – Change values live **Permissions** • `gentlefeet.use` – Allows barefoot protection • `gentlefeet.featherfall` – Allows feather falling benefit • `gentlefeet.admin` – Grants access to admin commands --- **How It Works** Barefoot walking prevents trampling entirely. When wearing boots with feather falling, protection from trampling scales: • Level I: 25% • Level II: 50% • Level III: 75% • Level IV: 100% Both systems can be configured independently. --- **Credits** Based on the original idea by **sammyt291** (FineFeet). This version is a complete rework with modernized structure, expanded features, and updated compatibility. ---
